Description: Hashview is a web front-end to hashcat with many powerful features geared towards penetration testers. Leverage task automation and real-time analytics for increased results and fancy reports. Hashview includes the following features: Automate workflow methodologiesCreate custom password cracking tasksUse data from previous jobs to increase cracking speedsFancy analytics useful for client reportsDistributed cracking Email/SMS NotificationsRetroactively crack hashes from previous jobsAdvanced searching of hashes, usernames, and plainsSmart wordlistsOptional community integration for accelerated cracking
